integrity: The previously known minimum-size formula is explicitly separated from the new all-minimum-set classification and count. One plausible residual risk is older literature under alternative terminology for target sets or irreversible conversion.
scientific limitations: Uniform thresholds only; the theorem classifies minimum conversion sets, not all conversion sets. The finite verifier checks complete multipartite graphs through order 8 but the infinite result rests on the proof.
title: Minimum \(k\)-conversion sets of complete multipartite graphs are weighted parking profiles
